latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Google Gemini — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video editing using Gemini AI for automatic trimming, captions, and highlight reels from user-uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Provides a seamless flow: connect, upload footage, describe desired edits, and receive 1080p MP4 exports—no manual editing required.
- Supports anonymous or token-based authentication, automatically handling session creation and credit management.
- Includes intent-based routing for commands like export, check credits, view status, and upload.
- Robust error handling and clear user messaging throughout the workflow.
- Optimized for content creators and marketers seeking quick, server-side video edits without technical overhead.
